title: "Climate Change AI Community: The world's first true stochastic climate physical-risk system goes open source."
summary: "RiskThinking.ai has launched the Climate Risk Commons, providing non-commercial researchers free access to their physical climate-risk engine. The initiative includes open frameworks, reference pipelines, and tools for advanced risk modeling, asset-level exposure analysis, and next-generation CMIP7 stress testing. Nineteen global institutions have already joined the platform, notably including research partners in Sweden alongside peers from Canada, the UK, Germany, and beyond."
